arxiv-2101-11608.title: Reduced Order and Surrogate Models for Gravitational Waves
arxiv-2101-11608.creator: Manuel Tiglio, Aarón Villanueva
arxiv-2101-11608.description: Abstract We present an introduction to some of the state of the art in reduced order and surrogate modeling in gravitational wave (GW) science. Approaches that we cover include Principal Component Analysis, Proper Orthogonal Decomposition, the Reduced Basis approach, the Empirical Interpolation Method, Reduced Order Quadratures, and Compressed Likelihood evaluations.

arxiv-2104-11072.title: cMLSGA: A Co-Evolutionary Multi-Level Selection Genetic Algorithm for Multi-Objective Optimization
arxiv-2104-11072.creator: P. A. Grudniewski, A. J. Sobey
arxiv-2104-11072.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by P. A. Grudniewski, A. J. Sobey. In practical optimisation the dominant characteristics of the problem are often not known prior. Therefore, there is a need to develop general solvers as it is not always possible to tailor a specialised approach to each application. The hybrid form of Multi-Level Selection Genetic Algorithm (MLSGA) already shows good performance on range of problems due to its diversity-first approach, which is rare among Evolutionary Algorithms.

arxiv-2509-04682.title: Ecologically Valid Benchmarking and Adaptive Attention: Scalable Marine Bioacoustic Monitoring
arxiv-2509-04682.creator: Nicholas R. Rasmussen, Rodrigue Rizk, Longwei Wang, KC Santosh
arxiv-2509-04682.description: Abstract Underwater Passive Acoustic Monitoring (UPAM) provides rich spatiotemporal data essential for long‑term ecological analysis, but intrinsic noise and complex signal dependencies hinder model stability and generalization. While multilayered windowing has improved target sound localization, the variability induced by shifting ambient noise, diverse propagation effects, and mixed biological and anthropogenic sources demands robust architectures and rigorous evaluation.

arxiv-2512-00246.title: Variable X-ray Emission of the Planet Hosting T Tauri Star CI Tau Journal: Astronomical Journal XSPEC (Arnaud 1996), CIAO (Fruscione et al. 2006)
arxiv-2512-00246.creator: Stephen L. Skinner, Manuel Güdel
arxiv-2512-00246.description: Abstract We report results of Chandra X-ray observations of CI Tau, a young magnetically active classical T Tauri star for which previous studies have reported periodic variability attributed to a massive planet in a short-period orbit. CI Tau was clearly detected by Chandra in four separate observations acquired in late 2023.

pmc-11434244.title: Acoustic Transmission Measurements for Extracting the Mechanical Properties of Complex 3D MEMS Transducers
pmc-11434244.creator: Dennis Becker, Moritz Littwin, Achim Bittner, Alfons Dehé
pmc-11434244.description: Recent publications on acoustic MEMS transducers present a new three-dimensional folded diaphragm that utilizes buried in-plane vibrating structures to increase the active area from a small chip volume. Characterization of the mechanical properties plays a key role in the development of new MEMS transducers, whereby established measurement methods are usually tailored to structures close to the sample surface.

pmc-11525168.title: Ion-mediated condensation controls the mechanics of mitotic chromosomes
pmc-11525168.creator: Hannes Witt, Janni Harju, Emma M. J. Chameau, Charlotte M. A. Bruinsma, Tinka V. M. Clement, Christian F. Nielsen, Ian D. Hickson, Erwin J. G. Peterman, Chase P. Broedersz, Gijs J. L. Wuite
pmc-11525168.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). During mitosis in eukaryotic cells, mechanical forces generated by the mitotic spindle pull the sister chromatids into the nascent daughter cells. How do mitotic chromosomes achieve the necessary mechanical stiffness and stability to maintain their integrity under these forces? Here we use optical tweezers to show that ions involved in physiological chromosome condensation are crucial for chromosomal stability, stiffness and viscous dissipation.

pmc-11618510.title: Polyethylene hydrogenolysis by dilute RuPt alloy to achieve H2-pressure-independent low methane selectivity
pmc-11618510.creator: Qikun Hu, Shuairen Qian, Yuqi Wang, Jiayang Zhao, Meng Jiang, Mingze Sun, Helai Huang, Tao Gan, Jun Ma, Jing Zhang, Yi Cheng, Zhiqiang Niu
pmc-11618510.description: Chemical recycling of plastic waste could reduce its environmental impact and create a more sustainable society. Hydrogenolysis is a viable method for polyolefin valorization but typically requires high hydrogen pressures to minimize methane production. Here, we circumvent this stringent requirement using dilute RuPt alloy to suppress the undesired terminal C–C scission under hydrogen-lean conditions.

pmc-11672701.title: Biosynthesis, Characterization, and Antibacterial Activity of Gold, Silver, and Bimetallic Nanoparticles Using Annona squamosa L. Leaves
pmc-11672701.creator: Fatima Jibrin, Olufunto T Fanoro, Rodney Maluleke, Thabang C Lebepe, Nande Mgedle, Gracia It Mwad Mbaz, Olanrewaju A Aladesuyi, Rajendran Kalimuthu, Oluwatoyin A Odeku, Oluwatobi S Oluwafemi, Marc Maresca, Helena Felgueiras
pmc-11672701.description: The utilization of nano-sized drug delivery systems in herbal drug delivery systems has a promising future for improving drug effectiveness and overcoming issues connected with herbal medicine. As a consequence, the use of nanocarriers as novel drug delivery systems for the improvement of traditional medicine is critical to combating infectious diseases globally.

pmc-12369150.title: A non-invasive preoperative model for predicting sentinel lymph node metastasis in breast cancer using clinical data and MRI
pmc-12369150.creator: Yunqing Yang, Zhulin Wang, Haidong Wang, Yun Wang, Yang Fu
pmc-12369150.description: IntroductionBreast cancer is the leading cause of cancer-related death among women, with metastasis accounting for the majority of these deaths. Sentinel lymph node (SLN) status is crucial for staging and treatment planning. This study aims to develop a non-invasive preoperative model for predicting SLN metastasis using clinical data and preoperative MRI.

pmc-12387859.title: Heterologous Expression and Antimicrobial Targets of a Novel Glycine-Rich Antimicrobial Peptide from Artemia franciscana
pmc-12387859.creator: Ming Tao, Aobo Sun, Huishi Shao, Huaiyuan Ye, Guangming Yu, Daigeng Chen, Wei Zhang, Tatiana V Ovchinnikova
pmc-12387859.description: The growing problem of antimicrobial resistance in aquaculture, caused by the excessive and unregulated use of antibiotics, highlights the critical necessity for developing new anti-infective solutions. Based on the characteristics of glycine-rich antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) and transcriptomic data, an antimicrobial peptide, namely AfRgly1, was discovered in this study. Subsequently, the peptide was obtained through heterologous expression in E.

pmc-12619781.title: Microvesicles secreted by CoCl2-primed mesenchymal stromal cells boost the functionality of hematopoietic stem cells cultured with them
pmc-12619781.creator: Shalmali Pendse, Vaijayanti Kale, Anuradha Vaidya
pmc-12619781.description: Rapid hematopoietic regeneration post-hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT) is vital for prompt immune recovery, infection prevention, and averting complications such as anemia and thrombocytopenia. The hematopoietic stem cells (HSCs) produce mature blood cells through a process known as hematopoiesis that is tightly regulated by the hypoxic bone marrow microenvironment.

pmc-13174186.title: Serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D and metabolic syndrome: a large cross-section study with dose response analysis in a health screening population
pmc-13174186.creator: Jia He, Ying-Yun Peng, Xiao-Kang Zhou, Yi-Na Shao, Hua-Fang Du, Hai-Zhen Wang, Tai-Wei Ye, Ying-Gang Chen
pmc-13174186.description: BackgroundThe association between serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D [25(OH)D] and metabolic syndrome (MetS) remains controversial, particularly in large-scale health-screening populations where early metabolic abnormalities can be detected. This study aimed to investigate the independent and potential non-linear association between serum 25(OH)D levels and MetS in adults undergoing routine health examinations.

pmc-13534865.title: Area of origin analysis for expirated patterns using HemoVision
pmc-13534865.creator: Lathursha Kalaranjan, Eugene Liscio
pmc-13534865.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Although bloodstain pattern analysis (BPA) can be performed on various types of patterns, there is a lack of research looking into whether the area of origin (AO) can be determined for expirated patterns. Expirated patterns are formed when blood is pushed out of an opening in the body by the force of air, in some cases forming a pattern of radiating bloodstains which can be analyzed similarly to impact patterns.

pmc-13607691.title: Auricular Reconstruction Following Traumatic Amputation: A Historical Review and Contemporary Treatment Algorithm
pmc-13607691.creator: Benedikt Fuchs, Vanessa Lucksch, Constanze Kuhlmann, Irene Mesas Aranda, Nikolaus Thierfelder, Sinan Mert, Paul Severin Wiggenhauser
pmc-13607691.description: Background: Traumatic auricular amputation represents a rare but complex reconstructive challenge, and numerous surgical techniques have been developed over the past century to optimize functional and aesthetic outcomes. This historical review examines current auricular reattachment and replantation strategies by comparing established surgical techniques for traumatic auricular amputation.
